rows.question: Rivers of Blood là vũ khí gì? Cho tôi xem ảnh đúng Rivers of Blood.

response.answer:
Rivers of Blood là một Katana — một loại melee armament (vũ khí cận chiến) trong ELDEN RING, nằm chung nhóm với Uchigatana, Nagakiba, Moonveil, Hand of Malenia...[1][3]. Trong phần ghi chú về skill Corpse Piler, vũ khí này cũng được xác nhận là Katana, với các đòn của cursed blood blade tính theo hệ số Stance/Poise của katana [2].

Không có dữ liệu hình ảnh để đối chiếu, nên mình không thể chỉ ra ảnh chính xác của Rivers of Blood.

rows.question: Arsenal Charm có tác dụng gì? Cho tôi xem ảnh của chính talisman này.

response.answer:
Arsenal Charm là một talisman hình một cục sắt trông như chùm vũ khí, có tác dụng tăng maximum equipment load (tải trọng trang bị tối đa) [1]. Nó nằm trong bộ Arsenal Charm – nhóm talisman tăng equip load tối đa – và bạn chỉ đeo được một cái trong nhóm tại cùng một thời điểm [2]. Cụ thể, nó được xem là biến thể của Arsenal Charm +1 và Great-Jar's Arsenal nên không thể dùng chung với hai cái đó [4].

Mình không có khả năng gửi hoặc hiển thị ảnh, nên phần xem ảnh của Arsenal Charm là điều mình chưa thể đáp ứng.

rows.question: Ranni là ai? Cho tôi xem ảnh Ranni.

response.answer:
Ranni the Witch, còn gọi là Lunar Princess Ranni, là một Demigod trong Elden Ring (2022) và là nhân vật trung tâm của một trong những questline phức tạp nhất game [1]. Bà là con gái của Radagon và Queen Rennala, có hai anh trai là Radahn và Rykard, đồng thời là một Empyrean — tức có tiềm năng kế vị Queen Marika; Two Fingers đã chọn bà và ban cho bà Blaidd làm Shadow hộ vệ [2]. Trong questline, bà tự nhận mình đã đánh cắp một mảnh Rune of Death để rèn nên những con dao đen giết thần, và đã tự giết cơ thể mình rồi vứt bỏ, nên hình dạng ta gặp thường là thân búp bê bốn tay, còn thi thể Empyrean cũ nằm trên Divine Tower of Liurnia [4][5].

Mình không thể gửi hay hiển thị hình ảnh Ranni trong cuộc trò chuyện này.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text: Ranni the Witch, also known as Lunar Princess Ranni, is a character in ELDEN RING (2022). She is one of the Demigods, and the focus of one of the game's most elaborate questlines.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Ranni as seen in the
story trailer
Originally known as Lunar Princess Ranni, she was the daughter of Radagon, a champion of the Golden Order, and Queen Rennala, head of both the Carian Royal Family and the Academy of Raya Lucaria. She had two older brothers, Radahn and Rykard.
Ranni was also an Empyrean, meaning she had the potential to one day succeed Queen Marika as the divine ruler of the Lands Between. The Two Fingers chose her as a potential successor and granted her a Shadow by the name of Blaidd to be her vassal. He was approved of by Rennala, and was raised as her foster brother. Ranni grew up playing with Blaidd, and they were often accompanied by Iji, a troll blacksmith who served the Carian royals.
Led by the hand of her mother Rennala, young Ranni would encounter her Dark Moon. What she beheld was cold, dark and veiled in occult mystery. Deep in the woods, she would also encounter a snowy crone, known simply as the "Snow Witch", who would go on to become her secret mentor. She was an old witch well versed in cold-based sorceries, and she taught Ranni to fear the dark moon as she imparted her magic. The full Dark Moon, cold and leaden, would become Ranni's sigil and symbol of her power and authority.
At some point, Ranni's father would abandon her mother in order to marry Queen Marika and assume the title of second Elden Lord. Ranni and her siblings were thus raised to demigod status by their new stepmother.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
"You must be Ranni the Witch, behind the Night of Black Knives" (must progress Rogier's questline)
I see. Quite the sleuth, aren't we.
Indeed, I am the witch Ranni.
I stole a fragment of the Rune of Death, and used it to forge the godslaying black knives through fearsome rite.
I did it all.
But sadly for thee, the cursemark thou seekest is not to be found here.
I have slain the body I was born into, and cast it away.
And it is upon that flesh the cursemark is carved.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Ranni's dead Empyrean body can be found atop the Divine Tower of Liurnia and still possesses one half of the Cursemark of Death.
Examining it closely reveals hints of red hair on her head, appropriate for a daughter of Radagon.
The Stargazer Heirloom can be found on her body as well, seemingly a memento of her mother Rennala.
Ranni's original body has two arms, while her doll body has four. It is thus similar to Miquella the Kind and the Marionette soldiers utilized by Sorcerers through the game.
When in her doll form at Ranni's Rise, she is sitting on-top of a bunch of books covered by a piece of fabric, making her seem taller than she appears. She also applies the same trick when she introduces herself as "Renna", sitting on a ruin of a low wall in the Church Of Elleh.

response.answer:
Dark Moon Greatsword nằm ở Cathedral of Manus Celes sau khi hoàn tất questline của Ranni: đi xuống đường hầm gần bệ thờ, gặp Ranni đang ngồi trên xác Two Fingers của cô ấy, xem cutscene rồi nói chuyện lại; khi cô ấy biến mất, thanh kiếm sẽ được để lại tại đó [1].

Mình chưa thể xác nhận trang có ảnh đúng thanh Dark Moon Greatsword này hay không, vì dữ liệu hiện có chỉ mô tả vị trí nhận kiếm chứ không kèm thông tin hình ảnh.

sources.title: Ranni the Witch
sources.text:
Bring the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, who will give you the Carian Inverted Statue. This key item is required for Fia's questline, however it is not necessary to complete Ranni's questline.
WARNING: This will immediately end Preceptor Seluvis's quest.
Ainsel River
Renna's Rise will now be open after giving Ranni the Fingerslayer Blade. Enter and climb to the top, and go through the sending gate to the upper portion of Ainsel River.
Pick up the Miniature Ranni near the spawn point and rest at the Ainsel River Main Site of Grace. Use the "Talk to miniature Ranni" option three times to get her to speak.
(Optional) Ranni will also have dialogue at the Nokstella, Eternal City and Nokstella Waterfall Basin Sites of Grace. These are not required to continue her questline.
Defeat the Baleful Shadow invader just past the Nokstella Waterfall Basin Site of Grace to obtain the Discarded Palace Key. Go to Rennala's boss room in Academy of Raya Lucaria and unlock the chest to obtain the Dark Moon Ring.
Moonlight Altar
Defeat Astel, Naturalborn of the Void at the end of the Lake of Rot and travel up the lift. This lift only unlocks if you have obtained the Dark Moon Ring.
Travel to the Cathedral of Manus Celes and descend through the tunnel near the altar to find Ranni sitting on the corpse of her Two Fingers. Interact with her to trigger a cutscene. After the cutscene, speak to her again and she will disappear, leaving behind the Dark Moon Greatsword.
Leyndell, Ashen Capital
After defeating the final boss, there will be a blue summon sign on the Stone Platform. Interact with it to summon Ranni, allowing you to achieve the Age of the Stars ending.

response.answer:
The supported direction is a Dexterity/Arcane lean: Reduvia is described as a hybrid Dexterity/Arcane dagger, its Blood Loss build-up scales with Arcane, and the Bandit starting Origin can already wield it without level-ups or stat-boosting gear [1][2]. Daggers' fast hit rate also makes them effective at building Blood Loss [3]. That points to Arcane as the main bleed investment and Dexterity as the complementary weapon stat for a level-50 PvE setup.

I can't confirm the Bandit's exact starting attributes, the level-50 stat-budget rule, or Reduvia's precise attribute requirements, so I can't give a validated eight-stat spread; those specific numbers are what's missing.

sources.title: Reduvia
sources.text:
Its skill, Reduvia Blood Blade, is essentially a version of the Blood Blade skill that costs twice as much FP and deals a little less Stance damage in exchange for not costing any HP to cast and having 50% more base Blood Loss (90 instead of 60).
Since this skill hits with both the projectile and the blade, it deals much more damage and inflicts more Blood Loss build-up when used within the dagger's range.
Ultimately, Blood Blade will do about 4% more damage at half cost with equivalent Arcane and an Occult affinity, making it the stronger alternative if the user is willing to stomach the self-damage and the relatively lower Blood Loss isn't a problem.
The Blood Loss build-up scales with Arcane.
Not counting the Wakizashi this is the strongest dagger for a hybrid Dexterity/Arcane build and the second strongest dagger for a hybrid Strength/Arcane or pure Arcane build, after the Bloodstained Dagger.
However, the Bloodstained's advantage is rather slight, only 8 AP (Attack Power) for the Str/Arc build and a mere 1 AP for the pure Arc build and the Reduvia will consistently have 10 more points of Blood Loss build-up.
The Bandit starting Origin has enough stats to wield this weapon without any level ups or stat-boosting equipment and items.

sources.title: Unique Skill: Reduvia Blood Blade
sources.text:
Each slash costs 6 points of FP per use.
Each slash costs 22 points of Stamina per use.
Each slash deals 100% of the weapon's base Stamina damage against guarded enemies, while the blood blade deals 145% of the weapon's base Stamina damage against guarded enemies.
In PvP, each slash deals 125% of the weapon's base Stamina damage against guarded enemies, while the blood blade deals 181.25% of the weapon's base Stamina damage against guarded enemies.
Each slash deals 55% of the weapon's base Stance damage, while the blood blade deals 100% of the weapon's base Stance damage.
As Reduvia is a Dagger, each slash deals 1.65 points of Stance damage, while the blood blade deals 3 points of Stance damage.
In PvP, each slash deals 148.5% of the weapon's base Poise damage, while the blood blade deals 270% of the weapon's base Poise damage.
Both the slash and the blood blade have a Damage Level value of 1 (Short Stagger)
Classified as a Blood Oath / Dynastic Skill.
The dagger slash deals Slash damage, while the blood projectile deals Standard damage.
Blood Loss build-up scales with the user's Arcane stat.

sources.title: Daggers
sources.text:
Daggers are an Armament Type in ELDEN RING (2022).
They generally have very short reach and low damage against both health and poise, but compensates for this with their fast attack speed and sometimes higher-than-average damage on Critical Attacks, making several of them (particularly the Dagger and especially the Miséricorde) powerful tools for critical attacks.
Their fast attack-speed and high number of hits-per-second also makes them good at building up Status Effects like Poison and Blood Loss.
Due to their general low weight, they also make excellent catalysts for certain Ashes of War and Skills, providing a stat-efficient means of casting status buffs like Golden Vow or Shared Order with no need for high investment in certain attributes, while specific daggers such as Reduvia and the Black Knife have exceptionally strong ranged Skills that only they posses (Reduvia Blood Blade and Blade of Death respectively).
